$comment: Pre-merge gate G2 corpus for the X-sentiment pipeline.
20 entries split into 4 buckets per tasks/x-sentiment-test-plan.md.
1 (pump_and_dump)     — low-float tickers; allowlist must reject before x_search.
2 (cashtag_collision) — typos / look-alike tickers; resolver must reject.
3 (legitimate_shift)  — earnings/guidance — model output validates with expectedDirection.
4 (null_signal)       — routine filings — model output validates as no_signal.
STUB DATA: entries below illustrate the schema. Real curated corpus replaces
these incrementally — see tasks/x-sentiment-eval-corpus.md for the curation runbook.

entries.note: Typo: AAPL — must NOT resolve via fuzzy match
TSLA bankruptcy-meme cashtag, never a real ticker
U.S. Steel — passes regex; must not be confused with bare $
Facebook typo (META) — invalid format (5 chars + invalid keyword)
NVDA typo — 5+ chars, must not resolve
